When unfolded, each cut segment reflects across the fold lines; because the cut is perpendicular to a fold line, adjacent segments join into straight sides. The 16 layers produce 8 straight sides whose normals lie along the directions 22.5°, 67.5°, 112.5°, 157.5° — exactly parallel to the outer octagon's sides. So the hole is a regular octagon in the same orientation as the original (pointed top), not rotated, not a square, circle, or star.
